test_title: PYST 68: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:

Some cars are electric.

All electric vehicles are eco-friendly.

Some eco-friendly things are expensive.

Conclusions

I. Some cars may be eco-friendly

II. Some expensive things are not cars.
solution:
Given : 

 
• Some cars are electric
 
• All Electric vehicles are Eco - friendly 
 
• Some eco - friendly things are expensive

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53c84466db7725894a7fc60ad98f07fe0ac70048f8d054cf0935b70f0823fa47.png] 

**Conclusions :**

**I. Some cars may be eco-friendly :****True (follows)**
In fact, it’s stronger: **Some cars are definitely eco-friendly** (because Cars → Electric → Eco-friendly)

II. Some expensive things are not cars : False (Does not follows )
We only know:

→Some Eco-friendly are Expensive

→But no definite relation between **Cars** and **Expensive**
→So we **cannot guarantee** that some expensive things are not cars.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence , The correct answer is** " Option 1 ".**
